intervals.label: commissioning run
intervals.quote: This project has been commissioned in 2021 and started data taking since then.

intervals.label: science operations
intervals.locator: end: PandaX collaboration slides, 2026/07/16, slide "Current Status"
intervals.note: The end is from the collaboration slides of 16 July 2026 give "Shut down at Apr. 15th"; the Run 2 physics data period ended earlier, "from July 5, 2024, to January 23, 2026" (arXiv:2607.02405). Run 1 ran 2021/11-2022/05 per the same slides, followed by a hall renovation at CJPL (2022/09-2023/12) during which the detector was not taking data; this interval is not split because no dated source for the gap is cited.
intervals.quote: This project has been commissioned in 2021 and started data taking since then.

intervals.label: PandaX-4T operation concluded (shut down)
intervals.note: Terminal event. Day from a collaboration talk slide (secondary); the CPS abstract says only that the experiment "concluded its operation and was decommissioned in May 2026". The successor PandaX-20T (xenon transferred to CJPL; "2028.1: PandaX-20T physics operation") is not an Atlas entity yet.

intervals.label: PandaX-4T decommissioned
intervals.locator: CPS HEP annual meeting abstract, 17 July 2026; slides: "Now: 4T has been diamantled [sic], 20T Xenon transferred to CJPL"
intervals.quote: After completing three data-taking runs, the PandaX-4T experiment concluded its operation and was decommissioned in May 2026.

name: PandaX-4T detector
notes: The detector phase (dual- or single-phase) is not recorded: no source consulted used "dual-phase"/"two-phase" for PandaX-4T specifically (the abstract of arXiv:2107.13438 uses neither term).

placements.quote: the PandaX-4T detector at the PandaX Dark-Matter Laboratory, 2400 m underground at the Jinping site in Sichuan

active_mass.quote: With 6-ton of total Xenon and 4-ton sensitive target

exposure.note: Exposure of the 2021 commissioning-run analysis only.

total_mass.quote: With 6-ton of total Xenon and 4-ton sensitive target

summary.plain: A tank of liquid xenon -- six tonnes in total, four tonnes of it the active target -- that records flashes of light from particles hitting xenon nuclei, deep under a mountain in China.
summary.technical: Xenon time projection chamber, 6 t total inventory / 4 t sensitive target (design); 3.7 t target mass used in the 2021 commissioning-run analysis. Located at CJPL-II, 2400 m underground.

technology.quote: Using a time projection chamber with 3.7-tonne of liquid xenon target
